'''Daigakuimo''' (Japanese: 大学芋) is a dish of Japanese candied sweet potato.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (½ [[Cookbook:Kg|kg]]) Japanese [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]]
*⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]]
*[[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]] for [[Cookbook:Frying|frying]]

==Procedure==
# Cut sweet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. 
# Heat the oil and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the sweet potatoes at 350°F (175°C) until brown. 
# Mix water, sugar, and soy sauce in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Put the pan on low heat. 
# When the liquid turns sticky, remove from the heat and add fried sweet potatoes. Quickly mix the potatoes with the sticky sugar. 
# Sprinkle sesame seeds over the coated sweet potatoes.
